releaseNotes:
Release v0.12.0

New Features:
- MeshDifferenceAction node — voxel-volume and surface-distance mesh comparison (PS-185)

Security & Hardening:
- Supply-chain scanning, SBOM generation, dependency remediation (PS-180)
- Webhook license owner resolved server-side, no longer trusts client custom_data (PS-182)
- Rate limiting, webhook replay dedup, generic errors, security-event logging (PS-184)
- Coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy + CRA triage process (PS-178)
- Firebase hardening; XFF-safe rate limiting (rightmost X-Forwarded-For)
- AI Act Art 50 transparency label on the AI Assistant panel
- Dependency modernization: React 19, rmcp 3.1, ~24 dependency updates

Infrastructure:
- First-party downloads via Cloudflare R2 with automatic website manifest publish

Bug Fixes:
- Bounds-check mesh indices before meshopt FFI

Docs:
- EU regulatory & security compliance audit; enterprise distribution corrections
